brief:
英伟达领导层地震主导今日市场情绪：亚洲股市在短暂下挫后重新买入科技股，油价则因特朗普称美国不必与伊朗达成协议而企稳反弹，风险溢价重新回到原油。香港老牌房企新世界发展停牌等待对投资者公告，此前刚录得创纪录年度亏损，地产信用压力仍是区域金融的隐忧。印度5.4万亿美元股市回暖，交易所与券商盈利前景改善；白银预计连续第六年供应短缺，澳大利亚基准国债收益率一年多来首次跌破美国同类，显示两国货币政策路径分化。AI仍是企业投资主线：高盛预计2027年AI将继续主导美国企业投资，另一项研究显示多数大型企业计划增加开放权重模型使用以压低账单。FT中文网则关注乌克兰星盾“系统性限速”与以军再次空袭加沙医院。

**Top 5**

1. [亚洲股市在英伟达动荡后上涨，油价企稳](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-12/stock-market-today-dow-s-p-live-updates) — 投资者把事件视为公司层面冲击，科技股重新获得买盘。
2. [新世界发展停牌，投资者等待下一步](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-13/new-world-suspends-trading-as-investors-watch-for-next-steps) — 刚公布创纪录年度亏损的房企准备向投资者作出公告。
3. [特朗普质疑伊朗协议必要性，油价反弹](https://www.wsj.com/business/energy-oil/oil-prices-fall-as-investors-weigh-u-s-iran-diplomacy-296e2847?mod=rss_worldnews) — 美国可能放弃与伊朗达成协议，令中东供应风险溢价回升。
4. [高盛：AI仍将是2027年美国企业投资的主导力量](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQazJqbUNYeFVEdEVPRmFkUEE3eVpESE8xb05HYUduM3A2N29kak93SEJLWHpUdng5NkdGQjBVdmhIUUZCNVF6eEs4MmZxNGU2NWxaOXh1cW0zNGlieDRVbExia3F5TnV4MGRJdTJIRWR3X19Dc3hNclcyMmxsQVhIZ2VtcGhPSWU5dkNETjJtWmVBSndERGVnZEZhcjRnWFJkdExWLTVTc0dnVTBkS3FZUW1qaWhEZw?oc=5) — 卖方仍把AI资本开支视为中期主线，但回报时滞争议未消。
5. [研究：多数大企业将增加开放权重AI以控制成本](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOYWVBOHhodjNxVmZ6Q05XeEJBOFlHNUFzTjRyMVBUMEtoOEgwRWJKT0dqWlU0RGo2ZmZFNm5nZ0ZYSXJydEZfbTJyUmxCQmc1OEhvMmlBc1N0aUJNZXFjb2FFM2Y3N0ZoQzN2bEZKcEU4N3pUeWxiYWhwT1kzUHdLTkwzSUJyZXhpSUxQck1RUzUzQ1JNa2EzV0hURFl6V3VsRDR5eUl1SzBVczN1WV9BTkU3cno?oc=5) — 成本压力正推动企业从单一前沿API转向混合模型架构。

items.title: Asian Stocks Gain After Nvidia Upheaval, Oil Holds: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Asian stocks climbed as investors eased back into technology shares amid fading concerns that a leadership crisis at Nvidia Corp. may derail the broader artificial-intelligence trade. Oil steadied.

items.title: Singtel Says ‘Fairly Insulated’ From Nvidia, Raises Guidance
items.summary: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd. said it is largely insulated from developments surrounding Nvidia Corp., with only a small share of its data-center capacity exposed to neocloud customers that may be linked to the chipmaker.

items.title: Compass Sues Multiple Listing Services, Upping Antitrust Row
items.summary: A feud over how consumers can buy and sell homes escalated on Thursday with a slew of antitrust lawsuits filed across the country by the top US broker for residential properties.

items.title: New World Suspends Trading as Investors Watch for Next Steps
items.summary: New World Development Co. has suspended trading in its shares, as the embattled real estate firm prepares to make an announcement to investors a month after reporting a record annual loss.

items.summary: Oil held gains after President Donald Trump said the US could forgo a deal with Iran, dimming prospects for a breakthrough to end the war that has roiled Middle East supplies.

items.summary: India’s $5.4 trillion equity market is bouncing back to life, creating a sweet spot for exchanges and brokerages as stronger trading activity brightens their earnings outlook.

items.title: Advent Again Seeks to Sell Singapore Tutor-Chain Learning Lab
items.summary: US buyout firm Advent International Corp. has put up Singapore’s tutor-chain The Learning Lab for sale, marking its second attempt since 2021 to unload the asset, in part to repay debt, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Silver Market Set for Deficit Even as Solar Makers Cut Back
items.summary: The silver market is set for a sixth straight annual supply deficit in 2026, even as solar manufacturers cut their use of the metal and investor selling eases pressure on the physical market.

items.title: Australia Bond Yield Falls Below US Peer as Rate Paths Diverge
items.summary: Australia’s benchmark bond yield fell below its US counterpart for the first time in more than a year as expectations for monetary policy in the two nations diverge.

items.summary: Oil prices rebounded from initial losses and closed higher after President Trump said the U.S. doesn’t need a deal with Iran, putting some risk premium back into the market.

items.title: 和谈之际乌克兰再遭星盾限速
items.summary: 泽连斯基称已连续数日遭到星盾“系统性限速”。乌克兰高官相信此举是为了在俄美乌三方谈判期间向基辅方面施压。

items.title: 以军再度空袭加沙医院
items.summary: 当地卫生部门称6名遇难者包括一名医生、几名患者及陪同人员。以军称袭击目标是藏匿于纳赛尔医院的哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅指挥官及其他武装人员。

items.title: 中国将严厉惩处离岸信托收益偷逃税者
items.summary: 中国政府要求中国富裕人士在10月22日的最后期限前完成对离岸信托收益的申报缴税，上月个人所得税收入同比增长90%。

items.title: 投资者对AI专用发电技术企业信心下降
items.summary: 投资者兴趣曾推动小型模块化核反应堆、地热能和燃料电池相关企业股价飙升，但这反过来意味着这些企业必须持续“烧钱”以完成项目。

items.title: 沙特石油产量回升至接近战前水平
items.summary: 欧佩克最大产油国10月原油日产量达到1060万桶，似乎表明它找到了维持石油工业运转的方法。

items.title: 美国科技股有望延续反弹趋势
items.summary: 新云服务商CoreWeave好于预期的业绩表现，以及Anthropic上市估值有望上调的消息，都提振了市场情绪。

items.title: 英伟达聘请前联邦检察官调查黄仁勋事件
items.summary: 纽约南区前代理联邦检察官金俊铉将负责对黄仁勋与一名据称是中国间谍的女子之间婚外情的内部调查。

items.title: 高中学历遭质疑 印尼副总统有意辞职
items.summary: 吉布兰在2024年参选时提交了一份高中“同等学历证明”，但该证明已被最高法院裁定无效。

items.title: 意大利银行业抨击梅洛尼政府最新增税计划
items.summary: 针对梅洛尼政府在未来三年向银行额外征税70亿欧元的计划，银行业协会负责人抱怨称这有违“经济理性”。

items.title: 美国10月环比通胀率放缓幅度不及预期
items.summary: 该月环比价格涨幅为0.4%，低于9月的0.6%，但高于经济学家们此前预测的0.3%。
